text: Total revenues were $3.415 billion, above the midpoint of the guidance range of $3.35 billion +/- $150 million; GAAP diluted EPS was $9.12 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $9.40, both above the midpoints of the respective guidance ranges; Cash flow from operating activities for the quarter and last twelve months were $707.5 million and $4.40 billion, respectively, and free cash flow was $622.3 million and $4.01 billion, respectively; Capital returns for the quarter and last twelve months were $874.8 million and $3.15 billion, respectively; and The Board of Directors approved an increase to the quarterly dividend level to $2.30 per share beginning with the dividend expected to be declared in May 2026 and an additional $7 billion for repurchases of our common stock.
